    | timestamp = 00:16:42.519
    | text      = Let's go light.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:43.519
    | text      = Just tell me about your music.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:44.519
    | text      = Let's start light.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:45.519
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:46.519
    | text      = Let's hear, and, and this solves a mystery that I've had for a long time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:49.759
    | text      = Who writes Willie Nelson songs?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:51.240
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.240
    | text      = Oh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:53.240
    | text      = Alex loves this song, Grave Digger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:55.779
    | text      = It's a lesser Willie Nelson song, but he plays it as a bumper constantly over years of time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:03.480
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:04.480
    | text      = And I know it really well from listening to Alex's show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:06.920
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:07.920
    | text      = And I never knew exactly why, but I think it's because it was the hit at the time when
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:13.559
    | text      = Willie came on Alex's show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:15.960
    | text      = That, that is truly an amazing, cause that makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:19.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:20.480
    | text      = And it's sort of a very rational, sentimental kind of attachment that you would have to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:25.240
    | text      = the song.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:26.240
    | text      = And yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:27.319
    | text      = And I've never heard it in any other context ever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:31.079
    | text      = There's plenty of Willie Nelson songs that are in the like world, you know, where it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:35.519
    | text      = like, I'm not trying to listen to a Willie Nelson song, but I will encounter one from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.559
    | text      = time to time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:40.559
    | text      = Beer for my horses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:41.720
    | text      = Never Grave Digger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:42.799
    | text      = Never.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:43.799
    | text      = Not once have I not, you have to like go out of your way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:45.880
    | text      = I do think it only exists in my life because of Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:49.319
    | text      = I agree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:50.319
    | text      = And it makes sense that it was the hit at this time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:53.599
    | text      = So they talk a little bit more about just some of the projects that Willie's got going
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:58.079
    | text      = on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:59.079
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:00.079
    | text      = What's going on?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:01.079
    | text      = And then we did another video that's coming out in a couple of months.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:05.480
    | text      = We did it down at my ranch there in Texas out there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:09.519
    | text      = And it was a video with me and Jessica Simpson and Owen Wilson and Woody Harrelson and all
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:15.519
    | text      = the Wilson boys and Ray Price and Johnny Bush.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:19.119
    | text      = And we just had a big crowd down there in town and we had a lawnmower race.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:23.200
    | text      = I wish you'd have been there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:24.200
    | text      = You'd have had a lot of fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:25.920
    | text      = I actually heard about it from Turk Pibkin and other people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:29.680
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:30.680
    | text      = But anyway, that's what we're into.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:34.960
    | text      = And we're out here doing a couple of songs off the album every night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:38.880
    | text      = You've got quite a few websites.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:40.519
    | text      = What are some of the sites people can visit to see your latest info?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:46.519
    | text      = Well there's a willienelson.com and my daughter does a column every day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:53.160
    | text      = Tell everybody what we're into out here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:55.359
    | text      = And there's the willienelsonpri.com, which is a website set up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:02.640
    | text      = I did it originally to try to organize all the peace organizations in the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:07.880
    | text      = And we did a pretty good job of doing that, I think, because there's a whole lot of networking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:13.400
    | text      = going on there about people talking about peace.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:16.559
    | text      = And then I wrote this song with my daughter Amy called Peaceful Solution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.160
    | text      = And I put the song on the website and told people they could record it, rewrite it, or
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:27.920
    | text      = sing it, or put their band behind it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:30.000
    | text      = I just gave them the song, basically.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:32.799
    | text      = And so far, over 100 people have recorded that song and videoed it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:38.319
    | text      = The University of Texas did two videos on it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:43.279
    | text      = Amazing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:44.279
    | text      = Go ahead, Willie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:45.279
    | text      = I'm just sayin', you know, I'm just foolin' around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:49.720
    | text      = Well it's fantastic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:50.720
    | text      = All of it, it seems like your music just gets better and better.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:53.920
    | text      = You are a driven individual, and that's what I want to ask you when we get back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:57.200
    | text      = What drives Willie Nelson?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:59.160
    | text      = What does Willie Nelson think is most important in this world?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:01.559
    | text      = What drives you as a human?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:04.200
    | text      = I think this is just like, I mean, at this point, it's kind of a, there's not much of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:11.160
    | text      = a vibe between them, there's not much chemistry at all, but it's just a normal-ass interview.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:16.660
    | text      = Talking about, like, eh, I made this website, I wanted to get all the peace organizations
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:19.839
    | text      = of the world together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:20.839
    | text      = Good for you!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:21.839
    | text      = Yeah!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:22.839
    | text      = Yeah!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:23.839
    | text      = I made this song called Peaceful Solution and wanted everybody to record a version of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:26.920
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:27.920
    | text      = Good for you!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:28.920
    | text      = This is great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:29.920
    | text      = It's got a very promotional interview.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:31.640
    | text      = It's like a professional interview, like, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:33.960
    | text      = Except with the weirdness of, we had a lawnmower race, wish you could've been there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:38.200
    | text      = Oh, I heard about it from Turk Pipkin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:39.599
    | text      = I don't believe you can have that name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:42.519
    | text      = I believe it's against the law, because that is a cartoon character's name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:46.519
    | text      = I can't take anything serious from Turk Pipkin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:48.720
    | text      = Well, you told Alex about the, uh, the lawnmower race.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:51.839
    | text      = That sounds like something Turk would say!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:54.079
    | text      = Turk, classic Turk Pipkin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:55.079
    | text      = Turk just running up out of nowhere, did you hear there's a lawnmower race going on?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:59.079
    | text      = God dammit, Turk!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:00.079
    | text      = Alex, you missed the lawnmower race.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:02.480
    | text      = There's something really fun about that moment, though, because there is, like, I feel like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:06.880
    | text      = there's an Alex trying to be like, I'm closer to your world than you realize, Willy, kind
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:11.900
    | text      = of thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:12.900
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:13.900
    | text      = You know, there's a, I knew about that, I knew about that lawnmower race before you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:16.039
    | text      = said it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:17.039
    | text      = Turk Pipkin told me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:18.400
    | text      = Of course!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:19.400
    | text      = Is that an imaginary friend?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:21.000
    | text      = No, that's a real person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:22.000
    | text      = Prove to me that's a real person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:24.000
    | text      = No, he's like a comedian, and he's a real person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:28.319
    | text      = Okay, alright.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:29.319
    | text      = I'll believe you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:30.319
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:31.319
    | text      = Pending time traveler from 2008 telling me otherwise.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:34.039
    | text      = So now, Alex comes back, and he wants to know about what drives Willy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:38.039
    | text      = Where does this, where does it come from?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:39.440
    | text      = And like, honestly, we have the makings of, like, a pretty good, interesting interview.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:45.240
    | text      = Oh my god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:46.240
    | text      = Willy talks about, like, his early days and, like, getting started and, you know, that's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:50.279
    | text      = good stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:51.279
    | text      = You're gonna pull the road on yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:52.279
    | text      = I mean, about your life, growing up, what made you the way you are, why you've always
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:58.119
    | text      = stood up for the little guy, the farmers and people in Africa, and just so many others,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:04.000
    | text      = why did you go in that direction in your life?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:07.559
    | text      = Well, you know, I don't really know, except the fact that I was, I grew up in a town in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:13.839
    | text      = Abbot, Texas, it was a little small community farm town, and I knew everybody in town, everybody
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:20.240
    | text      = knew me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:21.240
    | text      = We had three or four churches there, four churches, so in one way or another, you went
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:25.079
    | text      = to church every day and every night of your life, and I learned, if I learned anything,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:32.519
    | text      = I learned that all those places, you know, sometimes the Baptist wouldn't talk to the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:37.200
    | text      = Methodist or the Church of Christ wouldn't talk to the Catholics, but they were all trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:43.160
    | text      = to do the same thing, and they were just divisions, even in that small town, but the one thing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:49.960
    | text      = that I did learn out of it was the golden rule, you do unto others as you would have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:54.119
    | text      = them do unto you, and that's, maybe that in amazing grace, I pulled out of Abbot, Texas,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:59.920
    | text      = and I think those two things alone have been really good for me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:04.900
    | text      = When did you start your first band?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:07.960
    | text      = I was about 10, let's see, before I got out of high school, I started a band with me and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:16.000
    | text      = my sister and my brother-in-law and my football coach, and he played trombone, and we had
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:22.519
    | text      = a little family band, we played all over Texas, we played in Waco and West, and you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:30.799
    | text      = places that we could drive to with a trailer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:34.319
    | text      = Didn't you start out in radio by 16 or 17, you already had your own show?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:39.559
    | text      = Yeah, I was with KHBR in Hillsboro, and we had our own radio show there every Saturday,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:47.440
    | text      = and then after that I went to the Air Force and then went down to Pleasant in Texas and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:53.240
    | text      = went to work with KOB Pleasant down there, and then I worked at several other radio stations,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:59.000
    | text      = and at the same time playing bars around, trying to make it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:02.680
    | text      = It's amazing, well you certainly did make it a long career, you've been out, what, on
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:08.680
    | text      = the road and playing since what, 54, 55, earlier?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:13.119
    | text      = Yeah, at least that's the...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:15.359
    | text      = Whew!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:16.359
    | text      = I mean it's not Chris Farley, but it's not that far off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:19.200
    | text      = No!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:20.200
    | text      = That's what I'm saying!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:22.200
    | text      = You remember when you were a musician?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:24.720
    | text      = You remember that time?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:25.839
    | text      = But also it's interesting stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:27.359
    | text      = No, totally!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:28.359
    | text      = You were talking about interesting stuff that I could listen to him talk about, because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:33.039
    | text      = he actually says he started in like 49 or something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:35.680
    | text      = No, I'm so interested.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:37.160
    | text      = Going back to that, radio is such a different thing than it was then.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:42.759
    | text      = What was that like?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:43.960
    | text      = You're talking about starting a band with your siblings and then your gym coach.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:47.480
    | text      = Football coach?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:48.480
    | text      = Yeah, I mean what's going on?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:49.480
    | text      = Who plays trombone?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:50.480
    | text      = What's going on?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:51.480
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:52.480
    | text      = Yeah, no, I was so interested in that, and if I was talking to Willie Nelson, I'd be
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:56.079
    | text      = like, stop, don't give a shit about the rest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | timestamp = 00:48:04.599
    | text      = He got my address from Chris or somebody and said he wanted me to write him a song.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:07.880
    | text      = Chris Kristofferson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:11.199
    | text      = So I get it, like, the Highwaymen are great, you gotta bring them up, but it's a very strange
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:18.639
    | text      = articulation of a question to be like, I love Johnny Cash, I loved Waylon Jennings, what's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:23.079
    | text      = it like to be friends with them and then be dead?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:25.559
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:26.559
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:27.559
    | text      = Yeah!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:28.559
    | text      = What's it like to have your friends be dead?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:30.880
    | text      = I'm going to say this, and I know we've had a lot of evidence, but I think it's time to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:34.960
    | text      = really put the nail in the coffin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:36.719
    | text      = I do not think Alex is a good interviewer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:41.679
    | text      = I think it's a very different type of interview than you normally see from him, and it's very
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:49.360
    | text      = strange because...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:52.519
    | text      = Your famous friends are dead, what's that like?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:48:55.639
    | text      = There's an element of it that can be like, I think maybe what's behind the question is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:00.800
    | text      = something like, it really affected me losing them, their passing, how about you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:06.360
    | text      = Let's share things together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:08.639
    | text      = There's a piece of it that feels almost like an empathizing or something, but it's a very,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:13.480
    | text      = very strange thing to ask somebody, and Willie rolls with it fine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:18.760
    | text      = It does feel like such that kind of pathology of a robotic, narcissistic person trying to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:27.280
    | text      = perform the act of empathy, and it coming out, your friends are dead, are you okay?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:34.079
    | text      = What are you doing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:35.079
    | text      = Do you miss your dead friends?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:36.079
    | text      = Do you miss your dead friends?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:37.079
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:38.079
    | text      = Now there's something that I can't quite put my finger on, and that is that he brings up
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:42.000
    | text      = Johnny Cash and Waylon Jennings, but he does not bring up Chris Christopherson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:45.920
    | text      = Now Chris Christopherson's not dead, but he's also a bit more left leaning than-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:52.519
    | text      = Oh, Chris Christopherson and Alex would not get along.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:55.679
    | text      = No, so I can't tell if that's why he doesn't bring him up or if it's because he's still
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:01.960
    | text      = alive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:02.960
    | text      = It could be, it could be, but also part of those could be the same thing because Chris
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:07.719
    | text      = Christopherson also famously hit a lot of people real hard, so maybe you don't talk
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:13.659
    | text      = about Chris while he's still alive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:15.400
    | text      = Johnny, Willy's talking about him sentimentally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:20.880
    | text      = Waylon Jennings and Johnny Cash can't kill me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:23.440
    | text      = Chris Christopherson's still alive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:26.059
    | text      = So I think if there's one thing I can take away from my time observing Alex, it's that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:32.440
    | text      = he really, really likes the Highwaymen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:34.239
    | text      = Yeah, he really does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:35.760
    | text      = It's a sincere enjoyment and fandom that he has.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:39.800
    | text      = Well, I love all your music, but the Highwaymen, it's just, it's just, all of it's poetry.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:46.639
    | text      = I think there's some great songs, and Chip's moment is a really great producer, got a lot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:51.159
    | text      = of those songs together, and we did too, and we just sat around and figured out what we
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:55.360
    | text      = wanted to sing, and you know, I thought that there was some good songs in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:02.360
    | text      = What's your favorite Highwaymen song?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:06.360
    | text      = Oh, I like, I like the song, I Was a Highwayman, you know, the Jimmy Webb song, I like that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:15.639
    | text      = one a lot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:16.639
    | text      = In fact, change that, let's go out with I Was a Highwayman.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:19.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:20.000
    | text      = That's, I love that one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:21.000
    | text      = Well, but we're not going out yet, Willy, and I know you're really busy, you've given
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:24.440
    | text      = us an hour on the show ends, I'd like to talk to you just for a moment or two.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:28.119
    | text      = It's a good song.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:29.840
    | text      = It's called just Highwaymen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:31.119
    | text      = I'm more of a, I'm more of a greatest hits guy, I'm not really, I'm not really into the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:35.079
    | text      = catalog, sorry Alex, I'm not really a fan of my own stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:38.760
    | text      = Well, no, but hey, look, that said, that is a fucking great song.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:42.599
    | text      = It's a great song!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:43.599
    | text      = So, like, if that is your answer, that is a fine answer, even though it is, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:49.519
    | text      = maybe the greatest hits.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:50.880
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:51.880
    | text      = But, I mean, look, I should confess, I don't know tracks much deeper than the greatest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:58.199
    | text      = hits.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:59.199
    | text      = No, why would I?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:00.199
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:01.199
    | text      = I mean, I'm not saying that they're not great, but it's like, there's a lot of music to listen
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:04.199
    | text      = to, and I can't always go back and listen to all of the Highwaymen to just be, like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:09.400
    | text      = up to date.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:10.400
    | text      = I think Alex might have wanted him to say Silver Stallion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:12.440
    | text      = You think?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:13.440
    | text      = Maybe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:14.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:15.440
    | text      = Also, a fair amount of their songs were covers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:17.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:18.000
    | text      = Well, they're, you know, they were super great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:20.000
    | text      = But they're great, they're some great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:22.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:23.000
    | text      = They were there kind of doing their, let's get a lot of money thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:26.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:27.119
    | text      = Nothing wrong with it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:28.119
    | text      = No, no, nothing wrong with that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:29.480
    | text      = They were great at it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:30.480
    | text      = So, they talk a little bit about, you know, if shit goes down, if things go bad, then
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:36.000
    | text      = maybe we'll all have to return to subsistence farming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:38.639
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:39.639
    | text      = And because of this, Willie is very excited about urban gardening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:42.320
    | text      = Great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:43.320
    | text      = And, hey, tip my hat to that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:45.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:46.440
    | text      = And then things fall off the fucking rails.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:48.679
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:49.679
    | text      = And it's something we can do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:51.079
    | text      = In fact, all over Houston, New York, and cities now, people are using vacant lots and rooftops
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:57.360
    | text      = to grow, starting to grow their own vegetables.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:00.400
    | text      = And I think the way things are going, we all should be thinking about how can we sustain
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:06.679
    | text      = ourselves if gasoline is too expensive, or if there is no more, or if the roads get cut
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:12.760
    | text      = off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:13.760
    | text      = There's the weather problems that we've had, and from all indications, those things are
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:19.159
    | text      = going to get worse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:20.400
    | text      = Are you familiar with the Mayan calendar, by the way?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:23.360
    | text      = I am.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:24.360
    | text      = And it's clear we're going to have to do a part two if you'll do it in the next six months
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:28.280
    | text      = or so.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:29.280
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:30.280
    | text      = We'll have to do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:31.280
    | text      = We could talk about all those things, but it's obvious that the weather patterns are
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:34.480
    | text      = getting more severe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:35.480
    | text      = Well, look at the tsunamis.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:36.480
    | text      = I mean, in the last seven years, they've had more global disasters with more numbers killed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:41.360
    | text      = than the last 30 years before it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:43.159
    | text      = Two very important points.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:44.760
    | text      = One, Alex should not be into climate change type stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:48.920
    | text      = Nope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:49.920
    | text      = This is very strange to hear from him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:51.039
    | text      = Second, Will Nelson might be a 2012 Mayan apocalypse guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:54.800
    | text      = I love that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:56.539
    | text      = I think that's great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:58.280
    | text      = I think he's right on target.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:01.119
    | text      = Well, I mean, look.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:05.920
    | text      = I don't understand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:07.360
    | text      = Try and explain to me how it can be 2008 and you think the world's going to end in 2012.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:14.480
    | text      = You smoke a lot of weed?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:15.480
    | text      = But I mean, like, and you still, you're just touring?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:18.679
    | text      = Well, what are you supposed to do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:21.519
    | text      = That blows my mind.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:22.519
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:23.519
    | text      = Anything else?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:24.519
    | text      = It's just, I mean, it's just a theory that maybe he buys into.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:27.320
    | text      = Maybe it's not going to happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:28.320
    | text      = Who knows?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:29.320
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:30.320
    | text      = But one thing that you can tell is Alex is not interested in exploring that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:33.480
    | text      = We'll do a part two.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:34.480
    | text      = Part two.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:35.480
    | text      = We'll do a part two.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:36.480
    | text      = I'm going to give you topics in part two, though, and it will not be the Mayan calendar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:39.960
    | text      = That's not one I want to be associated with at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:42.440
    | text      = Nope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:43.440
    | text      = I believe a lot of weird shit, but not the Mayan calendar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:45.400
    | text      = I hang my hat on it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:46.840
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:47.840
    | text      = To Alex's credit, I guess we could say that that's one thing that he did not dance around
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:52.800
    | text      = with too much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:53.800
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:54.800
    | text      = And it's so fucking funny.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:55.800
    | text      = Here, Willie Nelson, are you familiar with the Mayan calendar?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:59.039
    | text      = Are you familiar with the mic?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:01.440
    | text      = But that's like, I mean, there's so many performers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:06.079
    | text      = There's so many musicians, all of that stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:10.780
    | text      = People have a perception of what these people might believe, but we've met some plenty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:15.480
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:16.480
    | text      = People project a lot onto public figures.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:19.320
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:20.320
    | text      = And there's people who are completely normal, everything like that, and then all of a sudden
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:24.239
    | text      = they'll say something, they'll be like, oh, you're out of your mind.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:26.960
    | text      = I did not realize that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:28.840
    | text      = Do you know about the underground dwelling?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:32.559
    | text      = I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:33.559
    | text      = I will see you, you know what, I'll see you tomorrow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:35.679
    | text      = That'd be great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:36.679
    | text      = We'll do the show tomorrow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:37.679
    | text      = And this really highlights, I think, a lot of the bizarreness of Willie, and especially
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:42.920
    | text      = this interview, is that he's got a lot of clearly what appear to be good intentions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:48.199
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:49.199
    | text      = There's a number of things that he's into that are pretty cool, like being opposed to
}}
